_comment: Explores the SR latch's Set/Reset dominance in examples/start_stop.json. SR is Set-dominant (S checked before R), and x_stop feeds R via a continuous NOT (not edge-triggered). So: (1) pressing start while stop is simultaneously held does NOT prevent the motor from turning on (S wins); (2) once on, holding stop while releasing start keeps R=False, so Q holds; (3) releasing stop afterward (with start already released) drives R=True and resets the motor.
